notes: Since 0.39.0 every post goes out through Ayrshare (ayrshare.rs, ayrshareService.ts, useAyrshare.tsx): one API key under Settings → Ayrshare (AyrshareSettings.tsx), one Ayrshare profile per brand (its key in Credential Manager as profile-<brandId>, Brand.ayrshare keeps refId/title), and the brand's socials linked on Ayrshare's page opened in the brand's window (posting.rs open_link_window fills each social's sign-in). X needs Nate's own X app keys (BYO since 2026-03-31).

The queue: postQueue.ts orders each brand's finished videos per social, and planSchedule puts them into the next free posting time (PostingSettings times, at most DAILY_LIMIT 3 a day per account, at most HORIZON_DAYS 21 ahead so Ayrshare's uploads stay). useAyrshare's auto-scheduler sends one at a time while the app is open; useFillSlots does the same on demand (Today, Calendar). Each brand's Schedule tab (BrandSchedule.tsx) shows its lanes. Video.scheduled holds each post's Ayrshare id and state; applyHistory (ayrsharePosting.ts) reads Ayrshare's history back as the truth.
summary: Posting and scheduling through Ayrshare: the API key, each brand's Ayrshare profile and linked socials, Post now, the auto-scheduling queue, and post states read back from Ayrshare
Shared accounts: two copies of the app (Nate's and his partner's) share brands, accounts, secrets and sign-ins through encrypted Firestore
Stories across multiple videos, with editable narratives, Grok continuations, parts and character reference pictures

notes: Settings → Look (LookSettings.tsx) sets html[data-theme] (Neon, Sunset, Ocean, Candy, Forest) and html[data-motion] (animations on/off) in localStorage, never the workspace. fun.css holds the themes, aurora background and all animations; it turns every animation off under prefers-reduced-motion or data-motion=calm. look.ts celebrate() throws confetti; App fires it for success messages that isCelebration() accepts (posted on, scheduled, live, created).
summary: The app's look: color themes, animations and confetti celebrations

notes: Week grid of everything Ayrshare will post (calendar.ts postsBetween groups a video's socials at the same minute), dashed open slots at the posting times, brand filter and colours, Fill open slots (useFillSlots), and a post's detail to move it (cancel + schedule again, Ayrshare has no move) or unschedule.
summary: Calendar page: the week of scheduled, posted and failed posts, open posting slots, posting times and Fill open slots

notes: ResultsProvider (useResults.tsx) reads Ayrshare analytics every 30 min: /analytics/social per brand (followers) and /analytics/post per post of the last 30 days (ayrshare_post_analytics, ayrshare_social_analytics in ayrshare.rs). results.ts reads each social's field names. Numbers and daily follower totals are cached in localStorage (socialspace.results.v1). Also a brand's Results tab.
summary: Results page: views, likes, new followers and comments from Ayrshare per range, brand and social, and the top videos

notes: Comments on posts of the last 14 days from Ayrshare GET /comments/:id (ayrshare_comments); replies go out with /comments/reply/:commentId (ayrshare_reply_comment, searchPlatformId, TikTok needs videoId). Grok drafts each reply (assistant/replyWriter.ts). Answered/skipped marks are kept on this PC; a reply from the brand's own account also counts as answered.
summary: Comments page: new comments from every social with Grok-drafted replies sent through Ayrshare
